comparisons.peer_topic: 2024 Restructuring Plan details and completion timeline
comparisons.peer_summary: In Q4 2024, AMD implemented a restructuring plan to align resources with AI and enterprise growth opportunities, primarily involving a 4% global workforce reduction. The company expects these actions to be substantially completed by the end of Q1 fiscal 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose significant internal operational restructuring in 2024 to align with strategic growth areas, specifically AI. Intel implemented an internal foundry operating model to separate design (Intel Products) from manufacturing (Intel Foundry), creating a specific internal foundry relationship. AMD implemented a 2024 Restructuring Plan to reduce global workforce by 4% to align resources with AI and enterprise markets. While Intel's change reorganized the business into distinct internal operating entities for manufacturing vs design, AMD's change focused on workforce reduction and cost efficiency for growth alignment.

sentences.text: We previously announced the implementation of our internal foundry operating model, which took effect in the first quarter of 2024, and creates a foundry relationship between our Intel Products business (collectively CCG, DCAI, and NEX) and our Intel Foundry business.
Intel Products consists substantially of design and development of CPUs and related solutions for external customers.

In the fourth quarter of 2024, the Company implemented a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan) focused on driving efficiencies and aligning resources with the Company's largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.
The 2024 Restructuring Plan will primarily reduce global workforce by approximately 4% of headcount.

comparisons.peer_summary: On April 23, 2024, the company acquired certain assets related to the design, development, and manufacture of System-on-Chip (SoC) operations from Seagate Technology Holdings plc for $600 million to strengthen its SoC product portfolio.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom (AVGO) disclosed significant changes to their semiconductor manufacturing or IP portfolio capabilities in 2024, though through different mechanisms. Intel established an internal foundry model to handle manufacturing services for its products and external customers. Broadcom acquired SoC operations from Seagate to strengthen its own product portfolio. Intel's move was an internal organizational shift to enable manufacturing services, while Broadcom's was an external acquisition to integrate specific design and manufacturing assets.

sentences.text: Intel Foundry consists substantially of process engineering, manufacturing, and foundry services groups that provide manufacturing, test, and assembly services to our Intel Products business and to external customers.
On April 23, 2024, we acquired certain assets related to the design, development, and manufacture of System-on-Chip ("SoC") operations of Seagate Technology Holdings plc for $600 million.
We acquired these assets to strengthen our portfolio of SoC products.

comparisons.peer_topic: Definition of Compute and Networking Business Unit (CNBU)
comparisons.peer_summary: The Compute and Networking Business Unit includes memory products and solutions sold into the data center, PC, graphics, and networking markets.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron (MU) defined specific business units or segments in 2024 to reflect their core revenue drivers and operational focus. Intel created 'Intel Products' (CCG, DCAI, NEX) and 'Intel Foundry' to separate CPU design from manufacturing. Micron defined its 'Compute and Networking Business Unit (CNBU)' to include memory products for data center, PC, and networking markets. Both disclosures highlight the shift towards focusing on high-growth segments like data center and AI-related computing infrastructure.
